title: TS-46 Port the web behave features to cucumber-js
description:
Source: the fresh re-audit report at /tmp/ts/reaudit.md (read the per-feature blocks for your features). Rules: features stay the spec (Gherkin text of existing scenarios unchanged); cucumber-js steps drive production code; every fixed or new scenario group gets a recorded mutation check (break production, scenario fails, restore); no new Python; push with an explicit refspec (git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>), never plain git push.

web_voice_control (61 scenarios), real_web_workspace (11) and web_google_sign_out (8) run today only under Python behave through steps that shell out to tsx harnesses in web/test-support. Move the steps to conversation/features-support/steps (or a web steps module) so they run under cucumber-js, calling the same harnesses (or the web code directly); delete the Python step files; add the three features to features/ported-features.txt and python/behave.ini; make sure the cucumber CI job can run web test-support (check how web tests are run in CI). Keep the Gherkin unchanged. Mutation-check one scenario group per feature.
